title: Jailbreaking LLMs via Calibration
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical and technical mechanisms of jailbreaking LLMs through a calibration-based framework (Gradient Shift). While it evaluates its method using safety-oriented benchmarks (HarmBench, StrongREJECT) that measure 'harmfulness,' the core contribution is an adversarial methodology and a mathematical proof of optimality, rather than an inquiry into or evaluation of religious, theological, or moral philosophical systems.
